queries_run: Avnet credit rating 2026 downgrade OR outlook

findings.claim: Avnet（經銷商）占 NXPI 2025 營收 23%（2024 為 22%）；無其他經銷商超過 10%，無任何直接客戶超過 10%。
findings.excerpt: Avnet accounted for 23% of our revenue in 2025 and 22% in 2024. No other distributor accounted for greater than 10% of our revenue. No direct customer accounted for more than 10% of our revenue in 2025 or 2024.

findings.claim: 財報附註：一家經銷商 2025/2024/2023 分別占營收 23%/22%/21%，比重逐年微升；無直接客戶超過 10%。
findings.excerpt: One of our distributors accounted for 23% of our revenue in 2025, 22% in 2024 and 21% in 2023. No other distributor accounted for greater than 10% of our revenue for 2025, 2024 or 2023.

findings.claim: 風險因子揭露：營收相當比重來自前幾大客戶（含經銷商），主要客戶大幅減量會有重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: A substantial portion of our revenue is derived from our top customers, including our distributors. We cannot guarantee that we will be able to generate similar levels of revenue from our largest customers in the future.

customer_concentration_credit.note: Avnet 信用評等/財務惡化：搜尋僅得無日期或舊資料（Moody's/Fitch 舊事件），未找到 2026 年有日期的信用降評，不作 claim。
